executor_address.description: executor is the account address used to execute the script

script_address.description: address is the script bech32 address to execute.

script_name.description: script_name is the optional nameservice name of the script to execute (e.g., "example.dys")

extra_code.description: Only if the executor is the owner of the script will the optional extra_code be temporary appended to the script for this message before calling the function

args.description: The positional arguments to pass to the function (*args) encoded as a json list

kwargs.description: The keyword arguments to pass to the function (**kwargs) encoded as a json dict

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

items.title: Any
items.description: Contains the serialized protocol buffer message using the response bytes from `/dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryEncodeJsonRequest`

attached_messages.description: The list of messages to run before the script.
